findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
2nd Repeat Violation

The following facility items are in need of repair:
1. Seal front counter to wall (silicon caulking) and remove existing damaged trim piece
2. Seal or replace broken trim behind garbage can to left was you walk into back space
3. Replace damaged base tile as you enter the walk-in cooler

Ensure these facility items are repaired prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed ice in the basin of the hand sink upon arrival. The hand sink appears to have been used for dumping a drink. PIC was informed that hand sinks may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. Ice was discarded.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.
